name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
short_desc: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to farmer families in three equal instalments.
who_benefits: All small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding
main_benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000 each, directly to bank account
eligibility: Farmer families with combined landholding up to 2 hectares (in most states). Excludes income taxpayers, institutional landholders, and constitutional post holders.
how_to_apply: Register at PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or through Common Service Centre (CSC) or local Patwari / Revenue officer
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
note: Benefits subject to state-wise land records verification. Check official portal for current eligibility.

name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
short_desc: Crop insurance scheme that protects farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
who_benefits: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops
main_benefit: Insurance coverage for crop loss due to natural disasters. Farmers pay very low premium (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops). Full remaining premium paid by government.
eligibility: Farmers with insurable interest in a notified crop during the notified season in the notified area. Available for loanee and non-loanee farmers.
how_to_apply: Apply through nearest bank, CSC, or Agriculture Department before the cut-off date. Loanee farmers enrolled automatically if notified crop taken as collateral.
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
note: Premium rates and coverage amounts vary by state and crop. Cut-off dates are season-specific.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
short_desc: Short-term credit facility for farmers to meet agricultural and allied activities needs at concessional interest rates.
who_benefits: Farmers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and SHGs/JLGs for crop production needs
main_benefit: Credit up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest per annum (4% effective with prompt repayment interest subvention). Covers crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities.
eligibility: All farmers — individual, joint borrowers, sharecroppers, tenant farmers. Animal husbandry and fisheries farmers also eligible for KCC.
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest bank (nationalized, cooperative, or regional rural bank) or PM-KISAN portal
source: RBI / NABARD / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
note: Interest subvention subject to central government scheme continuation. Verify current rates at your bank.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
short_desc: Provides farmers with soil health cards that carry crop-wise recommendations for fertiliser and nutrient doses.
main_benefit: Free soil testing and printed card with fertiliser and nutrient recommendations for 12 crops specific to the farmer's plot.
eligibility: All farmers. Soil samples collected by state agriculture department or authorised agencies.
documents: Land record / patta number for linking
how_to_apply: Contact local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), Agriculture department office, or check soilhealth.dac.gov.in
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
note: Soil Health Cards issued once every 2 years. Recommendations are advisory.

name: RKVY (Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana)
short_desc: State development scheme to incentivize states to enhance public investment in agriculture and allied sectors.
who_benefits: Farmers, FPOs, agriculture startups, and rural enterprises through state-implemented projects
main_benefit: Grants for agri-infrastructure, farm mechanization, post-harvest infrastructure, market linkage, and agri-entrepreneurship through Agri-SURE fund.
eligibility: Varies by state-implemented project. Individual farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, and agri-startups may be eligible depending on state scheme component.
documents: Varies by state and component. Typically: registration, land records, project proposal
how_to_apply: Contact state Agriculture Department or check state-specific RKVY portal
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
note: Implementation varies by state. Benefits and processes differ across components.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
short_desc: ₹1 lakh crore financing facility for post-harvest infrastructure and community farming assets.
who_benefits: Farmers, FPOs, PACs, cooperatives, agri-entrepreneurs, SHGs, and startups for farm-gate infrastructure
main_benefit: Loans up to ₹2 crore with 3% interest subvention for up to 7 years for cold storage, processing, sorting/grading units, warehousing, and primary processing.
eligibility: Farmers (individually or collectively), FPOs, PACs, cooperatives, startups, APMCs, and state agencies for specific bankable agri-infrastructure projects.
how_to_apply: Apply through banks or agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal. Banks empanelled under AIF process applications.
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
note: Subject to bank appraisal and scheme guidelines. Interest subvention subject to scheme continuation.

name: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
short_desc: Pan-India electronic trading portal for agricultural commodities, connecting farmers, traders, and buyers across states.
who_benefits: Farmers and FPOs for selling produce through transparent online auction to buyers across India
main_benefit: Transparent price discovery, wider buyer base, reduced intermediation, and direct payment. Farmers registered on e-NAM can sell without being limited to local mandi traders.
eligibility: Farmers in states with APMCs integrated with e-NAM. Registration at local APMC mandi required.
how_to_apply: Register at local APMC / mandi office. Mandi must be integrated with e-NAM.
source: Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC) / Ministry of Agriculture
note: Available only in states/mandis integrated with e-NAM. Coverage varies by state.

name: PM Kisan SAMPADA Yojana
short_desc: Scheme for Agro-Marine Processing and Development of Agro-Processing Clusters — supports food processing infrastructure.
who_benefits: Farmer groups, FPOs, cooperatives, and food processing entrepreneurs
main_benefit: Grant/credit support for food processing clusters, cold chain infrastructure, and primary processing units to reduce post-harvest losses.
eligibility: Eligible entities vary by sub-scheme. Includes farmers, SHGs, cooperatives, and entrepreneurs in food processing.
how_to_apply: Contact Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) or state food processing department
source: Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India
note: Multiple sub-schemes with different coverage. Verify current status on official portal.
